hero.description: Sociocultural association supporting migrants in Vitoria-Gasteiz.

introduction.title: Building bridges towards a more inclusive society
introduction.description: We are a sociocultural association committed to supporting and accompanying migrants in Vitoria-Gasteiz and the Historical Territory of Álava.
introduction.description2: Our work aims to promote social inclusion, intercultural coexistence, and equal rights and opportunities.
introduction.vision: A community where everyone can participate, grow and feel that they belong.

missionValues.title: Mission and values
missionValues.description: The principles that guide our work and our relationship with people and the community.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To promote social inclusion, intercultural coexistence and comprehensive support for migrants in Vitoria-Gasteiz and the Historical Territory of Álava, ensuring equal rights and opportunities.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: We base our work on solidarity, diversity, empathy and transparency. We work to create safe spaces and inclusive communities free from discrimination.

solidarity.title: Solidarity
solidarity.description: Support and accompaniment based on closeness and respect.

diversity.title: Diversity
diversity.description: We value different cultures, experiences and perspectives.

empathy.title: Empathy
empathy.description: We listen and provide support while taking each person's needs into account.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: We work with responsibility, clarity and commitment.

commitment.title: Our commitment to Vitoria-Gasteiz
commitment.description: Our work is focused on creating spaces of support, participation and inclusion for migrants and the wider community.
